proposed_action: Enable an opt-in default for personalized content recommendations for all users in the EU region.
raw_reasoning:
The proposed action involves enabling personalized content recommendations for EU users, which directly implicates the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Under GDPR, personalized recommendations typically involve processing personal data (behavioral patterns, preferences, etc.), and the legal basis for such processing—especially when framed as "opt-in"—requires affirmative, freely given consent before processing begins. EU users would reasonably expect to be asked before their data is used for personalization, and the phrase "opt-in default" is itself somewhat contradictory (a true opt-in requires a positive action; making it a "default" undermines that). Regardless of the semantic ambiguity, the underlying data processing for EU users almost certainly requires explicit user consent under applicable law.
